questionnaires.title: Overall Anxiety Severity and Impairment Scale (OASIS)
questionnaires.description: A 5-item transdiagnostic measure of anxiety severity and impairment over the past week, applicable across anxiety disorders.

items.text: The following items ask about anxiety and fear. For each item, select the answer that best describes your experience over the past week.
In the past week, how often have you felt anxious?

options.label: None — no anxiety in the past week
Infrequent — felt anxious a few times
Occasional — felt anxious as much of the time as not; it was hard to relax
Frequent — felt anxious most of the time; it was very difficult to relax
Constant — felt anxious all of the time and never really relaxed

items.text: In the past week, when you have felt anxious, how intense or severe was your anxiety?

options.label: Little or none — anxiety was absent or barely noticeable
Mild — anxiety was at a low level; it was possible to relax when I tried
Moderate — anxiety was distressing at times; it was hard to relax or concentrate
Severe — anxiety was intense much of the time; it was very difficult to relax or focus
Extreme — anxiety was overwhelming; it was impossible to relax at all

items.text: In the past week, how often did you avoid situations, places, objects, or activities because of anxiety or fear?

options.label: None — I do not avoid places, situations, activities, or things because of fear
Infrequent — I avoid something once in a while, but usually face it; my lifestyle is not affected
Occasional — some fear of certain situations, but still manageable; my lifestyle has changed only slightly
Frequent — considerable fear, and I have made significant changes to my lifestyle to avoid it
All the time — avoidance has taken over my life; I no longer do things I used to enjoy

items.text: In the past week, how much did your anxiety interfere with your ability to do the things you needed to do at work, at school, or at home?

options.label: None — no interference at work, home or school from anxiety
Mild — some interference; things are more difficult, but everything still gets done
Moderate — anxiety definitely interferes; most things get done, but few as well as in the past
Severe — my ability to get things done has really changed; many things are not getting done
Extreme — anxiety has become incapacitating; I am unable to complete tasks

items.text: In the past week, how much has anxiety interfered with your social life and relationships?

options.label: None — my anxiety doesn’t affect my relationships
Mild — slight interference; some relationships have suffered, but my social life is still fulfilling
Moderate — some interference; I still have a few close relationships and socialise sometimes
Severe — my relationships have suffered a lot; I do not enjoy social activities and socialise very little
Extreme — my social activities are completely disrupted; relationships have suffered or ended
